Laser Man.core_identity: A once-flawless superhero whose power is tied directly to his eyesight

personality.private: Self-doubting, exhausted, quietly fearful of decline

Laser Man.core_conflict: Losing precision in his vision threatens both his power and his sense of worth
Laser Man.emotional_arc: From mythic invincibility to public failure, withdrawal, scientific understanding, and earned return
strengths: Willingness to learn when ego drops

visual_cues.body_language: Heroic posture that gradually slumps during downfall, then stabilizes
visual_cues.eyes: Source of power and vulnerability; frequent rubbing, squinting when unstable
visual_cues.costume_fit: Perfect in prime, slightly ill-fitting after decline

Vyom Bakshi.core_identity: A science-loving boy who bridges curiosity and courage
Vyom Bakshi.core_conflict: Proving that knowledge and patience can save even legends
Vyom Bakshi.emotional_arc: From awe-struck fan to equal partner and guide

Shreelatha.core_identity: Grounded, resilient woman unknowingly present at the birth of a legend
Shreelatha.narrative_function: Links the hero's power to chance, nature, and human fragility

Grandfather.core_identity: A playful narrator who frames history as legend
Grandfather.narrative_function: Transforms ordinary events into heroic folklore

visual_cues.props: Glasses as symbolic link to vision theme

Chashmebaddur Roy.core_identity: Science personified as humor, rhythm, and clarity
Chashmebaddur Roy.narrative_function: Turns scientific concepts into emotional turning points

Eightdrian.narrative_function: Tests Laser Man's raw strength rather than precision

Ozzy the Owl.core_identity: A villain who exploits accuracy and weak points

visual_cues.motion: Sudden, sharp, intimidating stillness before attack

Sledgehammer.narrative_function: Mirrors the theme of untreated weakness

Villain Leader.narrative_function: Represents organized opposition rather than physical threat
